comparison.objective: Replace a blade in a quick-release holder and verify retention.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a spring collar open, remove/insert a blade, release the collar, and tug-test retention.
comparison.success_condition: Replacement blade is captured by the returned collar and survives a spring-carriage tug.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate a collar and verify retention, this record tests maintained release during component exchange; the candidate tests incremental damping adjustment, setscrew torque, and repeated non-bottoming stops.
